playstyle.identity: Syndra is a burst mage who manipulates dark spheres. Her ultimate launches all spheres at a target, dealing massive single-target burst.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q spawns a sphere. W picks up and throws spheres/minions. E pushes spheres and stuns enemies hit by them. R launches all spheres at one target (more spheres = more damage). Set up spheres with Q, use E-Q combo for stun, then R for execute.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Syndra spikes at level 6 with her burst ultimate. Luden's scales her damage. She's strong in lane and at bursting single targets.

passive.name: Transcendent
passive.summary: Gain Splinters from abilities; at 120 Splinters, upgrade abilities and gain bonus damage.
passive.details: Syndra gains Splinters from damaging champions and leveling. At 120, her abilities upgrade. She also gains permanent bonus damage after upgrading.

abilities.name: Dark Sphere
abilities.summary: Create a sphere that damages enemies.
abilities.details: Syndra conjures a dark sphere at a location, dealing damage to enemies. The sphere remains for several seconds.

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.summary: Pick up a sphere or minion and throw it.
abilities.details: Syndra grabs a sphere, minion, or monster. Recast to throw it, dealing damage and slowing enemies on impact.

abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
abilities.summary: Push spheres and enemies; enemies hit by spheres are stunned.
abilities.details: Syndra pushes enemies and spheres in a cone. Enemies hit by pushed spheres are stunned.

abilities.name: Unleashed Power
abilities.summary: Launch all spheres at an enemy, dealing massive damage.
abilities.details: Syndra launches all active spheres plus additional spheres at an enemy champion, dealing massive damage. More spheres = more damage.
